examples.english: Even at the holiday feast, he remained abstemious, eating only a small plate of vegetables.
examples.persian: حتی در جشن تعطیلات، او پرهیزکار در خوردن و نوشیدن باقی ماند و فقط یک بشقاب کوچک سبزیجات خورد.

miniContext: Even at the holiday feast, he remained abstemious, eating only a small plate of vegetables.

examples.english: The surgeon's adroit hands finished the delicate operation in record time.
examples.persian: دست‌های ماهر و چابک آن جراح، عمل حساس را در زمانی کوتاه و بی‌سابقه به پایان رساند.

miniContext: The surgeon's adroit hands finished the delicate operation in record time.

examples.english: Leaving without saying goodbye felt like a personal affront to the host.
examples.persian: رفتن بدون خداحافظی، برای میزبان مانند یک توهین شخصی بود.

miniContext: Leaving without saying goodbye felt like a personal affront to the host.

examples.english: Donating a kidney to a stranger was perhaps the most altruistic thing she had ever done.
examples.persian: اهدای یک کلیه به یک غریبه، شاید نوع‌دوستانه‌ترین کاری بود که او تا آن زمان انجام داده بود.

miniContext: Donating a kidney to a stranger was perhaps the most altruistic thing she had ever done.

examples.english: The new irrigation system helped ameliorate the drought's effect on local farms.
examples.persian: سیستم آبیاری جدید به بهبود بخشیدن اثر خشکسالی بر مزارع محلی کمک کرد.

miniContext: The new irrigation system helped ameliorate the drought's effect on local farms.

examples.english: A knight using a smartphone in the movie felt like a jarring anachronism.
examples.persian: دیدن یک شوالیه که در فیلم از گوشی هوشمند استفاده می‌کند، مانند یک ناهماهنگی زمانی آزاردهنده بود.

miniContext: A knight using a smartphone in the movie felt like a jarring anachronism.

examples.english: Her calm, orderly office was the complete antithesis of her chaotic bedroom at home.
examples.persian: دفتر آرام و منظم او کاملاً نقطه مقابل اتاق‌خواب درهم‌وبرهمش در خانه بود.

miniContext: Her calm, orderly office was the complete antithesis of her chaotic bedroom at home.

examples.english: The story about the founder sleeping in his car for a year is probably apocryphal.
examples.persian: داستان مربوط به اینکه بنیان‌گذار یک سال در ماشینش خوابیده، احتمالاً مشکوک و غیرقابل اثبات است.

miniContext: The story about the founder sleeping in his car for a year is probably apocryphal.

examples.english: The lonely cowboy riding into the sunset is an archetypal image in Western films.
examples.persian: گاوچران تنها که به‌سوی غروب خورشید می‌راند، تصویری نمونه اولیه و الگو در فیلم‌های وسترن است.

miniContext: The lonely cowboy riding into the sunset is an archetypal image in Western films.

examples.english: The monk led an ascetic life, sleeping on a wooden board and eating only rice.
examples.persian: آن راهب زندگی زاهدانه و ریاضت‌کشانه‌ای داشت، روی یک تخته چوبی می‌خوابید و فقط برنج می‌خورد.

miniContext: The monk led an ascetic life, sleeping on a wooden board and eating only rice.

examples.english: A warm cup of tea did little to assuage her worries before the flight.
examples.persian: یک فنجان چای گرم کمک چندانی به تسکین دادن نگرانی‌های او پیش از پرواز نکرد.

miniContext: A warm cup of tea did little to assuage her worries before the flight.

examples.english: The team's first win of the season was an auspicious start to a promising year.
examples.persian: اولین برد تیم در این فصل، شروعی نویدبخش و خوش‌یمن برای سالی پرامید بود.

miniContext: The team's first win of the season was an auspicious start to a promising year.

examples.english: The avaricious landlord raised the rent every single year, regardless of the tenants' income.
examples.persian: آن صاحبخانه حریص و طماع هر سال، بدون توجه به درآمد مستأجران، اجاره را افزایش می‌داد.

miniContext: The avaricious landlord raised the rent every single year, regardless of the tenants' income.

examples.english: After the scam, she became far more circumspect about sharing her bank details online.
examples.persian: پس از آن کلاهبرداری، او درباره به‌اشتراک‌گذاری اطلاعات بانکی‌اش آنلاین، بسیار محتاط‌تر و سنجیده‌تر شد.

miniContext: After the scam, she became far more circumspect about sharing her bank details online.

examples.english: The company found a clever way to circumvent the new import tax.
examples.persian: شرکت راهی هوشمندانه برای دور زدن و خنثی کردن مالیات وارداتی جدید پیدا کرد.

miniContext: The company found a clever way to circumvent the new import tax.

examples.english: Her salary was finally commensurate with her years of experience and responsibility.
examples.persian: حقوق او سرانجام متناسب و هم‌اندازه با سال‌ها تجربه و مسئولیتش شد.

miniContext: Her salary was finally commensurate with her years of experience and responsibility.

examples.english: Deciding which child should get the last ticket became a real conundrum for the parents.
examples.persian: تصمیم‌گیری درباره اینکه کدام بچه باید آخرین بلیت را بگیرد، برای والدین به معمایی دشوار تبدیل شد.

miniContext: Deciding which child should get the last ticket became a real conundrum for the parents.

examples.english: The small café had a convivial atmosphere, with neighbors chatting over coffee every morning.
examples.persian: آن کافه کوچک فضایی شاد و معاشرتی داشت و همسایه‌ها هر صبح با هم روی قهوه گفت‌وگو می‌کردند.

miniContext: The small café had a convivial atmosphere, with neighbors chatting over coffee every morning.

examples.english: There was a dearth of fresh vegetables in the market after the flood.
examples.persian: پس از سیل، کمبود شدیدی از سبزیجات تازه در بازار وجود داشت.

miniContext: There was a dearth of fresh vegetables in the market after the flood.

examples.english: He tried to denigrate his rival's work instead of improving his own.
examples.persian: او به‌جای بهتر کردن کار خودش، سعی کرد کار رقیبش را تحقیر کند.

miniContext: He tried to denigrate his rival's work instead of improving his own.

examples.english: There's a clear dichotomy between what politicians promise and what they actually deliver.
examples.persian: دوگانگی واضحی میان چیزی که سیاستمداران وعده می‌دهند و آنچه واقعاً انجام می‌دهند وجود دارد.

miniContext: There's a clear dichotomy between what politicians promise and what they actually deliver.

examples.english: The soft, diffuse light through the curtains made the room feel calm.
examples.persian: نور نرم و پراکنده‌ای که از پرده‌ها می‌تابید، اتاق را آرام جلوه می‌داد.

miniContext: The soft, diffuse light through the curtains made the room feel calm.

examples.english: The committee had to merge disparate opinions from five very different departments.
examples.persian: کمیته باید نظرات کاملاً متفاوت پنج بخش بسیار متفاوت را ادغام می‌کرد.

miniContext: The committee had to merge disparate opinions from five very different departments.

examples.english: The morning fog began to dissipate as soon as the sun rose above the hills.
examples.persian: به‌محض طلوع خورشید بالای تپه‌ها، مه صبحگاهی شروع به پراکنده و از بین رفتن کرد.

miniContext: The morning fog began to dissipate as soon as the sun rose above the hills.

examples.english: The long, humid afternoon seemed to enervate everyone at the outdoor festival.
examples.persian: آن بعدازظهر طولانی و مرطوب، همه را در آن فستیوال فضای باز ضعیف و بی‌حال کرد.

miniContext: The long, humid afternoon seemed to enervate everyone at the outdoor festival.

examples.english: His equivocal answer left us unsure whether he had actually agreed to the deal.
examples.persian: پاسخ دوپهلو و مبهم او ما را مطمئن نکرد که آیا او واقعاً با این توافق موافقت کرده است یا نه.

miniContext: His equivocal answer left us unsure whether he had actually agreed to the deal.

examples.english: The hotel charged an exorbitant fee just for parking a single car overnight.
examples.persian: هتل برای پارک کردن فقط یک خودرو در طول شب، هزینه‌ای بیش از حد و گزاف دریافت کرد.

miniContext: The hotel charged an exorbitant fee just for parking a single car overnight.

examples.english: Both sides remained intransigent during the negotiations, refusing to change a single term.
examples.persian: هر دو طرف در طول مذاکرات سازش‌ناپذیر باقی ماندند و حاضر به تغییر حتی یک بند نشدند.

miniContext: Both sides remained intransigent during the negotiations, refusing to change a single term.

examples.english: The funeral march's lugubrious melody matched the gray, rainy morning perfectly.
examples.persian: آهنگ غم‌انگیز و ماتم‌زده مارش عزا، کاملاً با آن صبح خاکستری و بارانی هماهنگ بود.

miniContext: The funeral march's lugubrious melody matched the gray, rainy morning perfectly.

examples.english: The politician's magniloquent speech was full of grand words but offered no real plan.
examples.persian: سخنرانی پرطمطراق و پرزرق‌وبرق آن سیاستمدار پر از کلمات بزرگ بود، اما هیچ طرح واقعی ارائه نمی‌داد.

miniContext: The politician's magniloquent speech was full of grand words but offered no real plan.
